pr_title: Bluetooth: Audio: Add Broadcast source application AD
pr_body:
This refactors how the BAP broadcast source handles the
extended and periodic advertising.

First it removes the start and stop of the extended
advertising, and instead expects the application
(or upper layers) to do this.

Second it exposes API functions to get the
necessary advertising data from BAP (service data and
the BASE), which the upper layers will then also
be responsible for setting and updating.

Signed-off-by: Emil Gydesen <emil.gydesen@nordicsemi.no>

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/49740
fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/47299
pr_comments:
I think there is an error in the commit text: The "set" in 
"Second it exposes API functions to set the necessary advertising data from BAP" 
seems like it should be a "get".

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Support for application-controlled advertisement for BAP broadcast source
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The current implementation of the BAP broadcaster is that it creates a non-connectable advertising set and advertises the device name, BAP broadcast service data and the BASE. 

However, this severely restricts the applications option to add additional information in the broadcasting set. This will also hinder completion of the PBP Broadcaster to use public APIs for the BAP broadcaster. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
The control of the advertising set and data should be left to the application. The BAP broadcaster implementation should be able to expose the necessary advertising data for that role (service data, BASE), and have the upper layers be responsible for setting it in the broadcasting data. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
This change will severely reduce the code size of the BAP broadcast source, and most of it will be move to higher layers. 

The change needed is quite similar to the change that was done for CSIS in https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/48025

review_comments:
`bt_audio_broadcast_source_get_id` was intended to be similar to `bt_csis_generate_rsi`, and simply output a fixed size value. 

However for the BASE, that isn't possible, as the BASE is dynamically sized. 

Any suggestions to how to better design the API is welcome. Perhaps all of them should just take a `net_buf_simple`?
